name: agent-forge
description: Local AI Engineering Orchestrator / Owner Control Center

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'commonjs'}, null, 2))"
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run build && npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npx @electron/rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
